title: Return of Frustratingly Easy Domain Adaptation
read: Introduction,3.1 covariance objective/derivation,3.2 regularized whitening-coloring algorithm and reverse-direction limitation; image/text tasks described. No biological experiments or extrapolation evidence in this paper.
adaptation: Own reverse-direction8D anchor-to-atlas alignment atprediction only with ridge.1 and partial strengths.25/.5/1; original source-to-target classifier retraining/ridge1 differs. Paper notes reverse direction performed worse in its classifiers. Mean-only control separates covariance mechanism. May erase actual population changes; no MMD/variogram or score improvement guaranteed.
